title: Classic Hamburger
description: Classic Hamburger is a premium beef burger featuring a juicy homemade patty, melted Swiss cheese, crispy bacon, caramelized onions, fresh vegetables, and creamy garlic aioli served on a toasted brioche bun. This restaurant-style recipe delivers rich flavor and an elegant continental presentation.

ingredients.title: For the Patty
items: Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste

ingredients.title: Toppings
items: 1 small red onion, thinly sliced and caramelized

instruction.title: 1. Prepare the Patty
steps: In a bowl, gently mix ground beef with shallot, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper.
Shape into two equal patties, slightly larger than the buns (they will shrink when cooked).
Chill patties for 15 minutes to help them hold shape.

instruction.title: 2. Cook the Patties
steps: Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook patties for about 3-4 minutes per side for medium doneness.
During the last minute, place cheese slices on top of patties and cover the pan to melt.

instruction.title: 3. Prepare the Sauce
steps: Combine mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, and garlic in a small bowl.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix well.

instruction.title: 4. Assemble the Burger
steps: Spread a generous layer of aioli on both bun halves.
On the bottom bun, layer lettuce, tomato, and pickles.
Top with caramelized onions and crispy bacon slices.
Close with the toasted top bun.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestion
items: Serve immediately with hand-cut fries or a light mixed green salad dressed with a mustard vinaigrette.

chefTips: Use high-quality ground beef with 20% fat for a juicy burger.
Chill the patties before cooking to help them hold their shape.
Rest the cooked patties for a few minutes before assembling to retain their juices.
Toast the brioche buns lightly for the best texture and flavor.
